interface.defaultPrompt: Review my Tally CSV export and explain my personal spending and cash flow.
interface.longDescription: Analyze Tally CSV exports and prepare spending history from the current chat as a Tally import file. Review coverage, unresolved entries and possible duplicates before importing in the Android app. No direct device or bank connection.

name: tally-companion
description: Review Tally spending exports and prepare chat spending history for reviewed import into Tally.
